args.title: Fix handling of double-quoted headers in CSV parsing
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Modify parsing of the header row to use splitFields function instead of raw split on commas, to correctly handle double-quoted column names that contain commas or quotes. This fixes the issue where the header columns are mismatched due to quoted headers leading to erroneous row shape errors.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is caused by the header row being split on raw commas which fails to correctly parse quoted column names. The file src/ingest/parser.ts handles CSV parsing and validation of row shapes, and needs to be fixed to use the same field splitting logic for the header as for the data rows. A draft pull request pr-58 has been opened to address this.
